name: Simulated particle sensors of a 100-floor tower, daily PM2.5 per sensor

spatialCoverage.name: Synthetic (open ocean at longitude 0, latitude 0; no real place)

description: SIMULATED data for a 100-floor tower flattened to a row of adjacent sensor geometries (400 sensor points; floor k is the 30 m by 30 m rectangle starting at x = 30(k-1) m, so height is the x axis). Daily PM2.5 reading of the sensor, one value per day of 2019. Particle levels rise with height by design and are illustrative, not physical. It is not a measurement of any real exposure.

about.name: ETL process for the simulated tower sensors
about.description: The CSV (WKT geometry plus a daily jsonb series) is published by the tower generator and loaded into a raw table with ogr2ogr; the postgis step builds the typed table, converts the series to jsonb, adds geom_local and the spatial index.

variableMeasured.name: sensor_type
variableMeasured.description: window (near an outer wall) or core

variableMeasured.name: pm25_sensor
variableMeasured.description: Daily PM2.5 reading of the sensor, stored as a jsonb object with date ranges as keys (startDate/endDate formatted as YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD) and PM2.5 values for each date key.
